title: Query strings
description:
Decode percent-encoded text and split a query string.

```
"q=caf%C3%A9+au+lait&page=2&empty=&flag"
q = café au lait
page = 2
empty = (empty)
flag = (no value)
```
hints: `std::isxdigit` checks the two characters after `%`; `std::stoi(s.substr(i + 1, 2), nullptr, 16)` reads them (lesson 3.03).
UTF-8 needs nothing special: `%C3%A9` is just two bytes that print as `é`.
requirements: `percentDecode` turns `%XX` into a byte and `+` into a space; a bad `%` sequence is an error.
Keep repeated keys (`tag=a&tag=b`) in order with a `std::multimap` or a vector of pairs.
stretch: Write `percentEncode` that keeps letters, digits and `-._~` and encodes everything else.
